data.name: CompressionPasswordRisk
data.value: Default: off. Passwords protect archive contents in ZIP, 7z and RAR. Losing the password makes recovery impractical; encryption may be unavailable in older archive apps.

data.name: CompressionAdvanced
data.value: Advanced options (cannot collapse during this task)

data.name: CompressionMethodRisk
data.value: 7z defaults to LZMA2; ZIP defaults to Deflate; RAR uses its native codec. LZMA2 in ZIP and Deflate in 7z are unsupported. Other codecs may not be readable by older archive programs.

data.name: CompressionLevelRisk
data.value: 0 stores data with little compression; ZIP/7z allow up to 9, RAR up to 5. High levels can take much longer and consume more CPU and memory, stalling low-spec devices.

data.name: CompressionDictionaryRisk
data.value: 7z and RAR only. A larger dictionary can improve compression but requires similar memory for decompression; very large values can fail or freeze low-memory devices. ZIP Deflate ignores this value.

data.name: CompressionThreadsRisk
data.value: More threads can use more memory and CPU and make other apps unresponsive. A low value slows compression. The decoder may still need substantial memory.

data.name: CompressionMemoryRisk
data.value: Too low a limit may make compression fail or force a slower mode. A very high limit can exhaust RAM and make the system unresponsive.

data.name: CompressionVolumeRisk
data.value: Split archives require every numbered part to extract. Some archive apps cannot open split ZIP/7z archives; losing one part can make later data inaccessible.

data.value: Invalid or incompatible compression setting. Check the supported range and algorithm for this format.

data.name: CliHelp
data.value: TANGERINE ZIP command line TANGERINE-ZIP.exe help [command] TANGERINE-ZIP.exe compress <output> <source>... [options] TANGERINE-ZIP.exe extract <archive> <destination> [options] TANGERINE-ZIP.exe list <archive> [options] Run help compress, help extract, or help list for parameters. No arguments opens the GUI.

data.name: CliHelp_compress
data.value: compress <output> <source>... [options] --format zip|7z|rar|tar|gz|bz2|xz|lz4|zst|iso|wim (default: output extension) --password TEXT | --password-env NAME --level 0..9 --method Default|Deflate|LZMA2 --dictionary MiB --threads N (0=auto) --memory-limit MiB (0=unlimited) --volume MiB (0=single file) Advanced options apply to ZIP, 7z, and RAR. Existing output is rejected. Use -- before paths that begin with --.

data.name: CliHelp_extract
data.value: extract <archive> <destination> [options] --password TEXT | --password-env NAME --encoding NAME (archive entry names) --entry PATH (repeat to select members) --on-conflict abort|overwrite|skip (default: abort) --on-issue abort|skip (default: abort; includes unsafe paths and suspicious sizes)

data.name: CliHelp_list
